name: Worker runs to completion against the live grievance_deadlines schema
Concurrent workers (3) claim each due reminder exactly once
One immutable execution row per claimed attempt (no duplicate delivery records)
detail: 12 reminders with executions; max per reminder=1

name: Failed delivery is recorded as failure/retry (not silent success) with email disabled
Expired lease from an interrupted worker is recovered and the reminder is re-processed
Unexpired lease held by another worker is not stolen
Failed deliveries reach a bounded terminal state (dead_letter) and never exceed max_attempts
Re-running the worker over terminal reminders does not create duplicate execution records
Empty queue run reports zero work distinctly from failure
